title: Finally made peace with renting as a good choice for first timers
body: I was at a family gathering recently where my niece was asking about buying her first home. Everyone else was saying how it's the best investment ever and that she should just go for it, but I had to speak up. I reminded them that 30 years ago when we were in our early twenties, renting made more sense for us financially. We could save on maintenance costs and use those funds towards paying off debt. It's not always about owning vs renting, it's about what makes the most financial sense for where you are in life.

title: Mesh Wi-Fi is overkill for most of us
body: I've been diving deep into setting up a home network lately, and I really think people overcomplicate things. Everyone is pushing for a full mesh system, but honestly, for a house of three bedrooms, a really good single router with some good range extenders is more than enough. The constant need to chase the absolute fastest theoretical speed just seems like unnecessary hassle and wasted money. I'm finding that I can get a solid, reliable connection without needing every single node in the house, which saves me a ton of setup time and headache. Simplicity is key when you're just trying to get the internet to work reliably.
